units.source_text: 关于我父母的葬礼，我已了无印象。

en.t: I no longer have any impression of my parents' funerals.

units.source_text: 他们健在的情形，我也全无记忆了。

en.t: I have no memory at all of what they were like when they were alive.

units.source_text: 人们对我说，别把双亲忘却了，想想吧！

en.t: People told me not to forget my parents, and to try to think of them.

units.source_text: 可我苦思冥想，也无法想象出来。

en.t: But no matter how hard I thought, I could not picture them.

units.source_text: 看了照片，只觉得它不是画像，不是活着的人，而是一种介乎两者之间的东西。

en.t: When I looked at their photographs, they seemed neither portraits nor living people, but something in between.

units.source_text: 既不是亲人，也不是外人，而是介于他们中间的人。

en.t: They were neither family nor strangers, but people somewhere between the two.

units.source_text: 它使我感到一种奇异的压迫感，连和照片彼此照面，也都觉得不好意思。

en.t: They made me feel a strange pressure, and even facing their photographs felt embarrassing.

units.source_text: 就是别人谈及我父母的情况，我也不知该以什么样的心情聆听才好，只希望谈话早点结束。

en.t: Even when others spoke about my parents, I did not know what feelings I should listen with, and only wished the conversation would end soon.

units.source_text: 别人告诉我他们的忌辰和年寿，我也如同记电车的车号，马上就忘得一干二净。

en.t: When people told me their death anniversaries and ages, I remembered them like streetcar numbers and soon forgot them completely.

units.source_text: 我从姨母处听说，举行父亲葬礼那天，我又哭又闹，

en.t: I heard from my aunt that on the day of my father's funeral, I cried and made a scene,

units.source_text: 不许在灵前敲钲，要把供灯熄灭，将灯油全倒在院子里……

en.t: refusing to let them strike the gong before the spirit, trying to put out the offering lamp, and pouring all the lamp oil into the garden...

units.source_text: 只有这件事，竟莫名其妙地拨动我的心弦。

en.t: Only this incident, for some inexplicable reason, touched a chord in my heart.
